name: apportionment
description: Apportion seats among districts by population with Huntington-Hill, Webster (Sainte-Laguë), Jefferson (D'Hondt), Adams or Hamilton (largest remainder), with a minimum number of seats per district. Exact arithmetic; shows each district's quota, the order and priority values of the seats awarded, and ties for the last seat.

min_seats.description: Seats every district gets first; huntington_hill and adams always give at least 1

catalog.source: original; methods as in Balinski & Young, Fair Representation (1982), and 2 U.S.C. 2a (Huntington-Hill with one seat per state), checked against Wikipedia's Huntington-Hill, Sainte-Laguë and Largest remainder examples
